cues.text: You call me when the room gets quiet
Say my name like you still mean it
I know the road that brought you here
One wrong turn, one old souvenir
But I won't wait beside the phone
If you want me, make it known
Come on, come on, come on, don't let it pass
Say what you mean and make it last
Come on, come on, meet me halfway
We can begin again today
You keep your promise in your pocket
Folded up and barely honest
I see the hope behind your eyes
So leave the careful words behind
Step out, speak up, no more maybe
Show me the heart that you kept from saving
One clear answer, one straight line
If you want this, now's the time
Come on, come on, don't let it pass
Say what you mean and make it last
Come on, come on, meet me halfway
We can begin again today
